The '''KR-770 targeting computer''' was a model of [[Advanced targeting computer/Legends|advanced targeting computer]] available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was produced by the company [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] and cost 4000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], improving the accuracy of the [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]].
